policy: This ledger records conclusions from the reference investigation without publishing raw private machine logs. Reproduce with repository diagnostics before generalizing to another model.

evidence.claim: GNOME Wayland multi-GPU is a catastrophic freeze trigger on the reference machine
key_signals: i915 and nouveau initialize before failure
Mutter accelerated iGPU/dGPU framebuffer sharing fails

evidence.claim: X11 dual-GPU avoids the specific Wayland freeze path
Intel i915/Crocus direct hardware acceleration works
Apple gmux can route the internal panel to Intel
key_signals: automatic return to discrete path succeeds

evidence.claim: Intel-primary Xorg is fluid and usable
NVIDIA PRIME render offload works while Intel is Xorg primary
key_signals: NVIDIA light stress produces no new GPU faults

evidence.claim: Firmware/default semantics currently mark NVIDIA as boot/default GPU
OpenCore 1.0.7 boots successfully with validated reference config
Correct-format runtime creation of gpu-power-prefs is rejected on the reference machine
Nouveau INVALID_VALUE errors correlate with Chromium launch rather than initial GNOME login glitch
key_signals: Chromium later owns NVIDIA render node
DATA_ERROR timestamps begin after Chromium launch

evidence.claim: Reference stable checkpoint contains no gpu-power-prefs and no experimental persistent Xorg GPU override
